ul.li: Gather at KLIA
Flight to Copenhagen
Arrive Copenhagen Airport, pickup
Gefion Fountain (cascaded fountain & largest monument in Copenhagen)
Little Mermaid Statue (bronze & granite sculpture inspired by the Hans Christian Andersen fairy tale)
Rosenborg Castle & King's Garden (est. 17th century, was King Christian IV's private garden, the oldest and most visited park in central Copenhagen)
Amalienborg Palace (home to the Royal Danish Family)
Strøget (car-free pedestrian shopping street, one of the longest in Europe)
Nyhavn (vibrant and colourful waterfront district)
Land transfer from Copenhagen to Malmö
Øresund Bridge (iconic 16km bridge linking Denmark & Sweden, comprising a bridge, an artificial island and an underwater tunnel)
Check-in
Check-out
Land transfer from Malmö to Norrköping
Luftkastellet (scenic spot for the Øresund Bridge viewpoint)
Lund (medieval city, cobblestones and half-timbered houses)
Jönköping (picturesque lakeside city)
Lake Vättern (most beautiful and 2nd largest lake in Sweden)
Norrköping (located at the mouth of the Motala River, which drains Lake Vättern into the Baltic Sea)
Check-in
Land transfer from Norrköping to Stockholm
Stockholm (Sweden's capital, known as the 'Venice of the North')
Royal Palace (official residence & royal palace of the Swedish monarch)
Stockholm Grand Mosque (largest mosque in Stockholm)
Gamla Stan (medieval old town with charming streets)
Stortorget (medieval square with colourful architecture & old Swedish charm)
Optional: Vasa Museum (Scandinavia's most visited museum, home to the world's only well-preserved 17th-century ship)
Transfer to Enköping
Check-out
Land transfer from Enköping to Oslo
Örebro (one of the most beautiful city centres in Sweden)
Örebro Castle (impressive blend of medieval and Renaissance architecture)
Lake Vänern (largest lake in Sweden & the EU, with 22,000 islands)
Karlstad (located on the north shore of Lake Vänern, Sweden's sunniest city)
Oslo (Norway's capital, with Oslofjord, natural beauty, Viking heritage, modern architecture and cultural scene)
Check-in
King's Palace (official residence of the Norwegian royal family)
National Theatre (venue showcasing Norway's cultural performances)
Stortinget (the supreme legislature of Norway, established in 1814)
Oslo Opera House (home of the Norwegian National Opera and Ballet)
Gronland Mosque (headquarters of the World Islamic Mission, one of the biggest Muslim congregations in Norway)
Karl Johans Gate (main street lined with shops, cafes, street performers)
Aker Brygge (vibrant waterfront in Oslo offering food, shopping, culture and nature experiences)
Optional: Norsk Folkemuseum (open-air museum with 160 historic buildings)
Optional: Fram Museum (Norway's polar exploration, with the original Fram ship)
Check-out
Land transfer from Oslo to Bergen
Geilo (mountain town known for skiing and outdoor adventures)
Vøringsfossen (Norway's most famous waterfall, with a 182m drop)
Eidfjord (scenic fjord village surrounded by mountains & nature)
Hardangerfjord (majestic fjord with glacier views — Norway's 2nd longest and the world's 5th, stretching 179km from the Atlantic Ocean)
Bergen (Norway's 2nd largest city, surrounded by the UNESCO-listed Norwegian fjords, one of the world's most popular attractions)
Check-in
Bergenhus Fortress (historic coastal fortress, one of Norway's oldest and best-preserved fortifications)
Håkonshallen (the largest royal residence, built in the 13th century by King Håkon Håkonsson, over 750 years old)
Nordnes Park (peaceful seaside park with walking trails & ocean views)
Bryggen Harbour (UNESCO-listed old Hanseatic wharf and buildings, one of North Europe's oldest port cities)
Bergen Moské (Bergen Mosque)
Bergen Fish Market (picturesque fish market, among Norway's most visited outdoor markets — seafood, fruit and vegetables)
Optional: The Fløibanen (ride the funicular railway to the top of Mount Fløyen for a panoramic view of Bergen City)
Check-out
Land transfer from Bergen to Gudvangen
Tvindefossen (waterfall featuring multiple streams of water cascading down rugged rocks)
Gudvangen (one of four villages along the Aurlandsfjord & Nærøyfjord, surrounded by towering cliffs and waterfalls)
Optional: Njardarheimr Viking Valley (living history town in Norway showcasing Viking life and culture)
Nærøyfjord Boat Safari (boat ride through the UNESCO-listed fjord with dramatic mountain scenery from Gudvangen to Flåm)

Flåmsbana Train Ride (one of the best train journeys in the world, through dramatic fjord and mountain scenery)
Kjosfossen Waterfall (waterfall only accessible via the Flåmsbana)
Land transfer from Myrdal to Geilo
Check-in
Itinerary may change on tour day without prior notice, subject to weather and traffic conditions
Land transfer from Geilo to Oslo
Flight to Kuala Lumpur
Arrive Kuala Lumpur

div.div: Includes: Entrance to the museum, admission to all exhibits, including the preserved Vasa ship and its surrounding displays
Excludes: Tour guide, purchase at the restaurant or gift shop, personal expenses
Duration: Opening hours Sept-May 10:00-17:00, Jun-Aug 08:30-18:00. Can be done after the city tour, suggested around 1.5-2 hours
Includes: Entrance to the museum, including the open-air museum, permanent exhibitions, theme exhibitions, and any ongoing events or programs
Excludes: Tour guide, purchase at the restaurant or gift shop, personal expenses
Duration: Opening hours Oct-Apr 11:00-16:00, May-Sep 10:00-17:00. Can be done after the city tour, suggested around 2 hours
Includes: Entrance to the museum, including the ability to explore the iconic polar ship, Fram
Excludes: Tour guide, purchase at the restaurant or gift shop, personal expenses
Duration: Opening hours Oct-Apr 10:00-17:00, May-Sep 09:30-18:00. Can be done after the city tour, suggested around 1-2 hours
Includes: Round-trip ride to the top of Mount Fløyen (~6 minutes per way), including the playground, cafeteria and gift shop at the top
Excludes: Tour guide, extra activities (canoe, paddleboard, mountain bike), purchase at the restaurant or gift shop, personal expenses
Duration: Opening hours Mon-Fri 07:30-00:00, Sat-Sun 08:00-00:00. Can be done after the city tour, suggested around 1-1.5 hours
Includes: Viking experience tour, access to the Viking Village, and activities like axe throwing and archery
Excludes: Purchase at the restaurant or gift shop, personal expenses
Duration: Available Mon-Fri 10:00-18:00, April-October only. Suggested around 1-1.5 hours
